passages.text: Blood pressure is the force of blood pushing against blood vessel walls as your heart pumps out blood. High blood pressure, also called hypertension, is an increase in the amount of force that blood places on blood vessels as it moves through the body.
Most people with high blood pressure do not have symptoms. In rare cases, high blood pressure can cause headaches.
